lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a grid-like distribution posterior to the gill slits. Spot size decreases and spatial density increases towards the ventral-pectoral junction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a lattice-like appearance across the anterior mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow-cast low intensity on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes are visible in the ventral region near the pectoral fin.
